method: Content spot-check via Claude (Cowork): the six pages, plus eCFR, were re-checked by a scheduled weekly review and their key facts compared against the cited claims on this site. This cloud environment cannot make raw outbound requests for a byte-level hash; see monitor.py for a portable script that does a true SHA-256 check when run somewhere with normal internet access (e.g. your own machine).
